examples.en: The caption under the photo explained where it was taken.
examples.zh: 照片下方的说明文字解释了拍摄地点。

examples.en: The flood left widespread devastation across the small town.
examples.zh: 洪水给这座小镇带来了大面积的毁坏。

examples.en: The young racer won his first big competition yesterday.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的赛车手昨天赢得了他的第一场大型比赛。

examples.en: We must safeguard our personal data from online thieves.
examples.zh: 我们必须保护个人数据,防止被网络窃贼盗取。

examples.en: The butterfly begins life as a tiny larva.
examples.zh: 蝴蝶的生命始于一只微小的幼虫。

examples.en: The famous rapper performed new songs at the concert.
examples.zh: 那位著名的说唱歌手在演唱会上表演了新歌。

examples.en: People with diabetes often need daily insulin injections.
examples.zh: 糖尿病患者通常需要每天注射胰岛素。

examples.en: We usually stop for lunch at midday.
examples.zh: 我们通常在正午时分停下来吃午饭。

examples.en: This course takes an interdisciplinary approach to learning.
examples.zh: 这门课程采用跨学科的学习方法。

examples.en: The barber gave him a short, neat haircut.
examples.zh: 理发师给他剪了一个干净利落的短发。

examples.en: The soldier loaded a fresh cartridge into his rifle.
examples.zh: 士兵往步枪里装上了一枚新的弹药筒。

examples.en: Radioactive fallout spread far after the nuclear test.
examples.zh: 核试验后,放射性微尘扩散到很远的地方。

examples.en: You should heed your teacher's careful advice.
examples.zh: 你应该留心老师的细心建议。

examples.en: He lost his savings in an online scam.
examples.zh: 他在一场网络骗局中损失了全部积蓄。

examples.en: Mosquitoes can spread malaria in tropical countries.
examples.zh: 在热带国家,蚊子会传播疟疾。

examples.en: The news showed horrific scenes after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 新闻播放了地震后令人毛骨悚然的场面。

examples.en: The old bridge is unsafe to cross now.
examples.zh: 那座旧桥现在过起来不安全。

examples.en: His avoidance of the topic made everyone uneasy.
examples.zh: 他对这个话题的回避让大家都感到不安。

examples.en: People often liken life to a long journey.
examples.zh: 人们常把人生比喻成一段漫长的旅程。

examples.en: We had scant time to finish the test.
examples.zh: 我们完成考试的时间很不充分。

examples.en: She is allergic to peanuts and avoids them.
examples.zh: 她对花生过敏,所以避免食用。

examples.en: The drunk man walked with an unsteady lurch.
examples.zh: 那个醉汉走起路来步履蹒跚。

examples.en: Starting a new business is always a gamble.
examples.zh: 创办一家新企业总是一场冒险。

examples.en: We went for a brisk walk in the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园里轻快地散了一会儿步。

examples.en: The government offered a bounty for catching the criminal.
examples.zh: 政府为抓捕这名罪犯提供了奖励金。

examples.en: She gave an authoritative answer to the question.
examples.zh: 她对这个问题给出了权威性的回答。

examples.en: Grandma sat in her favorite wooden rocker.
examples.zh: 奶奶坐在她最喜欢的木摇椅上。

examples.en: His constant noise caused me great irritation.
examples.zh: 他不停的噪音让我十分烦恼。

examples.en: He came ostensibly to help, but wanted money.
examples.zh: 他表面上是来帮忙,实际上是想要钱。

examples.en: The disease slowly led to total blindness.
examples.zh: 这种疾病慢慢导致了完全失明。

examples.en: The dog kept scratching because of a flea.
examples.zh: 那只狗因为身上有跳蚤而不停地挠痒。

examples.en: The engineer watched the control console carefully.
examples.zh: 工程师仔细地盯着控制台。

examples.en: Eating too much fatty food is unhealthy.
examples.zh: 吃太多油腻的食物对身体不好。

examples.en: The leaders met to reaffirm their old promises.
examples.zh: 领导人们会面以重申他们旧有的承诺。

examples.en: After the accident, he fell into a deep coma.
examples.zh: 事故发生后,他陷入了深度昏迷。

examples.en: The choir sang a beautiful hymn on Sunday.
examples.zh: 唱诗班在周日唱了一首优美的赞美诗。

examples.en: The whole town came to the spring gala.
examples.zh: 全镇的人都来参加春季的节日庆典。

examples.en: The long jumper trained hard every morning.
examples.zh: 那位跳远运动员每天早晨刻苦训练。

examples.en: A good teacher is patient and tolerant.
examples.zh: 一位好老师既有耐心又宽容。

examples.en: Everyone stayed quiet during the solemn ceremony.
examples.zh: 在庄严的仪式上,大家都保持安静。

examples.en: Heavy rainfall flooded the streets last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的大雨淹没了街道。

examples.en: The slow heave of the waves rocked the boat.
examples.zh: 海浪缓缓的起伏摇晃着小船。

examples.en: Most doctors concur that exercise is good.
examples.zh: 大多数医生都同意锻炼有益健康。

examples.en: She added some cranberry sauce to the turkey.
examples.zh: 她给火鸡加了一些越橘酱。

examples.en: He showed total disregard for the safety rules.
examples.zh: 他完全无视了安全规则。

examples.en: The baker brushed a sweet glaze over the cake.
examples.zh: 面包师在蛋糕上刷了一层甜甜的糖衣。

examples.en: The hunter's hound chased the rabbit through the field.
examples.zh: 猎人的猎犬穿过田野追赶兔子。

examples.en: She voted by proxy because she was away.
examples.zh: 因为不在场,她委托代理人投了票。

examples.en: The baby slept peacefully in her wooden crib.
examples.zh: 婴儿在她的木制小床里安静地睡着。

examples.en: She felt a deep dread before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前她心中充满了深深的恐惧。

examples.en: Fishing is the main livelihood in this village.
examples.zh: 捕鱼是这个村子的主要生计。

examples.en: The chemist mixed two liquids in the lab.
examples.zh: 化学家在实验室里把两种液体混合在一起。

examples.en: Girls outnumber boys in our English class.
examples.zh: 在我们的英语班上,女生人数多于男生。

examples.en: He hit the ball with a small wooden paddle.
examples.zh: 他用一块小木拍击球。

examples.en: The factory follows stringent safety rules.
examples.zh: 这家工厂遵守严格的安全规定。

examples.en: We had spaghetti with tomato sauce for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们晚餐吃了番茄酱意大利面。

examples.en: Young children learn the alphabet at school.
examples.zh: 小孩子在学校学习字母表。

examples.en: A pentagon is a shape with five sides.
examples.zh: 五边形是一种有五条边的图形。

examples.en: The word "apple" has two syllables.
examples.zh: 单词“apple”有两个音节。

examples.en: Sleep deprivation made it hard to concentrate.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足让人很难集中注意力。

examples.en: The doctor gave him medicine to reduce inflammation.
examples.zh: 医生给了他药来减轻炎症。

examples.en: These old walls were built from limestone.
examples.zh: 这些古老的墙是用石灰石砌成的。

examples.en: We enjoyed the expansive view from the hill.
examples.zh: 我们欣赏着从山上望去的广阔景色。

examples.en: Remember to punctuate your sentences correctly.
examples.zh: 记得给你的句子正确地加上标点。

examples.en: The school has special teachers for children with autism.
examples.zh: 这所学校有专门照顾孤独症儿童的老师。

examples.en: Motherhood changed her life in many ways.
examples.zh: 为人母在许多方面改变了她的生活。

examples.en: They will inscribe his name on the gold medal.
examples.zh: 他们会把他的名字刻在金牌上。

examples.en: The road project is federally funded.
examples.zh: 这个道路工程由联邦政府出资。

examples.en: Her neat handwriting is easy to read.
examples.zh: 她工整的笔迹很容易辨认。

examples.en: A good breakfast can energize you for the day.
examples.zh: 一顿丰盛的早餐能让你一整天精力充沛。

examples.en: The farmer used a prod to move the cattle.
examples.zh: 农民用一根刺棒赶动牛群。

examples.en: The new play found a wealthy backer.
examples.zh: 这部新剧找到了一位富有的资助人。

examples.en: Factories should not pollute the river.
examples.zh: 工厂不应该污染河流。

examples.en: He felt clumsy while dancing at the party.
examples.zh: 在派对上跳舞时,他觉得自己很笨拙。

examples.en: The singular form of "mice" is "mouse".
examples.zh: “mice”的单数形式是“mouse”。

examples.en: People criticized the leader for his hypocrisy.
examples.zh: 人们批评这位领导人的虚伪。

examples.en: Soldiers guarded the lonely outpost in the desert.
examples.zh: 士兵们守卫着沙漠中孤零零的前哨。

examples.en: He hung a coil of rope on the wall.
examples.zh: 他把一卷绳子挂在墙上。

examples.en: From her smile, I infer she passed the exam.
examples.zh: 从她的微笑,我推断她通过了考试。

examples.en: The coach gave a short motivational speech.
examples.zh: 教练做了一段简短的励志演讲。

examples.en: A huge stone portal led into the old castle.
examples.zh: 一座巨大的石门通向这座古老的城堡。

examples.en: The children read a story before bedtime.
examples.zh: 孩子们在睡觉前读了一个故事。

examples.en: She instinctively covered her face from the sun.
examples.zh: 她本能地遮住脸,挡住阳光。

examples.en: The priest read a verse from the scripture.
examples.zh: 牧师诵读了一段圣经的经文。

examples.en: The lion was kept captive in a small cage.
examples.zh: 那头狮子被关在一个小笼子里。

examples.en: His political views lean toward conservatism.
examples.zh: 他的政治观点偏向保守主义。

examples.en: There was no overt sign of trouble.
examples.zh: 没有任何明显的麻烦迹象。

examples.en: The teacher asked for textual evidence from the story.
examples.zh: 老师要求从故事中找出文本依据。

examples.en: The oil cartel controlled prices for years.
examples.zh: 这个石油卡特尔多年来控制着价格。

examples.en: She has long, curly brown hair.
examples.zh: 她有一头长长的棕色卷发。

examples.en: He ordered a glass of gin at the bar.
examples.zh: 他在酒吧点了一杯杜松子酒。

examples.en: Please keep a duplicate of this important file.
examples.zh: 请保留这份重要文件的副本。

examples.en: The fundamentalist group rejected all modern ideas.
examples.zh: 这个基要主义团体排斥一切现代思想。

examples.en: His demands were completely unreasonable.
examples.zh: 他的要求完全不合理。

examples.en: Wash your hands to remove germs.
examples.zh: 洗手以清除细菌。

examples.en: I decided to rename the file for clarity.
examples.zh: 为了清晰起见,我决定给这个文件改名。

examples.en: The publisher will reprint the popular book.
examples.zh: 出版商将重印这本畅销书。

examples.en: She became hysterical when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 听到这个消息时,她变得歇斯底里。

examples.en: I bought some cough medicine at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 我在药房买了一些止咳药。

examples.en: She has a natural affinity for music.
examples.zh: 她对音乐有一种天生的亲近感。

examples.en: He joined a college fraternity in his first year.
examples.zh: 他在大一时加入了一个大学生联谊会。

examples.en: He worked hard to redeem his good name.
examples.zh: 他努力工作以挽回自己的好名声。

examples.en: I love the richness of this chocolate cake.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这款巧克力蛋糕的浓郁口感。

examples.en: Spending all his money was sheer folly.
examples.zh: 把所有钱都花光实在是愚蠢之举。

examples.en: The thick weeds began to strangle the young plants.
examples.zh: 茂密的杂草开始把幼苗扼杀。

examples.en: These are only unofficial results so far.
examples.zh: 到目前为止,这些只是非正式的结果。

examples.en: The little pup followed its mother everywhere.
examples.zh: 那只小狗到哪里都跟着它的妈妈。

examples.en: A stray dog wandered into our garden.
examples.zh: 一只走失的狗游荡进了我们的花园。

examples.en: We ordered soup as an appetizer.
examples.zh: 我们点了汤作为开胃菜。

examples.en: I had a hunch that it would rain today.
examples.zh: 我有种预感,今天会下雨。

examples.en: She wore a chic black dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿着一条别致的黑色连衣裙去参加派对。

examples.en: The lineman blocked the runner near the goal.
examples.zh: 那名锋线球员在球门附近拦住了跑动的球员。

examples.en: The museum displays a replica of the old ship.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了那艘古船的复制品。

examples.en: The clever fox managed to elude the hunters.
examples.zh: 那只聪明的狐狸设法躲开了猎人。

examples.en: A small contingent of students joined the trip.
examples.zh: 一小队学生加入了这次旅行。

examples.en: He lay in a lazy sprawl on the sofa.
examples.zh: 他懒洋洋地伸开手脚躺在沙发上。

examples.en: The team relies on company sponsorship to compete.
examples.zh: 这支队伍依靠公司的赞助来参赛。

examples.en: She gave us a firsthand account of the trip.
examples.zh: 她向我们讲述了这次旅行的第一手见闻。

examples.en: A huge oil tanker entered the busy port.
examples.zh: 一艘巨大的油轮驶入了繁忙的港口。

examples.en: She won a fellowship to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她获得了一份去国外深造的奖学金。

examples.en: We walked along the rocky shoreline at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分,我们沿着多石的海岸线散步。

examples.en: The weather was dreadful during our holiday.
examples.zh: 我们度假期间的天气糟糕透了。

examples.en: A nervous twitch appeared near his left eye.
examples.zh: 他左眼附近出现了一阵紧张的抽搐。

examples.en: An army brigade was sent to the border.
examples.zh: 一个旅的部队被派往边境。

examples.en: We admired the elegance of the old palace.
examples.zh: 我们赞叹这座古老宫殿的优雅。

examples.en: The designer studies the aesthetics of clean lines.
examples.zh: 这位设计师研究简洁线条的美学。

examples.en: Safety is of paramount importance at this factory.
examples.zh: 在这家工厂,安全是最重要的事。

examples.en: She wiped the table with a wet sponge.
examples.zh: 她用一块湿海绵擦了擦桌子。

examples.en: Please buy a carton of milk on your way home.
examples.zh: 回家路上请买一盒牛奶。

examples.en: A few words of thanks will suffice.
examples.zh: 几句感谢的话就足够了。

examples.en: Kind words can engender trust between people.
examples.zh: 善意的话语能在人与人之间产生信任。

examples.en: The skilled artisan made beautiful wooden bowls.
examples.zh: 这位熟练的工匠制作了精美的木碗。

examples.en: We wasted time on needless arguments.
examples.zh: 我们在不必要的争吵上浪费了时间。

examples.en: The teacher noticed an inconsistency in his story.
examples.zh: 老师注意到他的故事前后不一致。

examples.en: The stars arrived at the show in a long limo.
examples.zh: 明星们乘坐一辆加长豪华轿车来到现场。

examples.en: She spent two years writing her dissertation.
examples.zh: 她花了两年时间撰写她的论文。

examples.en: We grilled some fresh asparagus for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们烤了一些新鲜的芦笋作为晚餐。

examples.en: He felt powerless to stop the argument.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己无力阻止这场争吵。

examples.en: Medical terminology can be hard to understand.
examples.zh: 医学术语可能很难理解。

examples.en: Call me tomorrow, preferably in the morning.
examples.zh: 明天给我打电话,最好是在上午。

examples.en: She let out a shriek when she saw the spider.
examples.zh: 看到蜘蛛时,她发出一声尖叫。

examples.en: The bathroom window is made of opaque glass.
examples.zh: 浴室的窗户是用不透明玻璃做的。

examples.en: The boat ride gave him a feeling of nausea.
examples.zh: 坐船让他感到一阵恶心。

examples.en: She studies optics and the behavior of light.
examples.zh: 她研究光学和光的特性。

examples.en: Speeding cars are a menace to children.
examples.zh: 超速的汽车对孩子们是一种威胁。

examples.en: A small cactus sat on her sunny windowsill.
examples.zh: 一盆小仙人掌放在她阳光充足的窗台上。

examples.en: They explored the mountains on horseback.
examples.zh: 他们骑马探索了那些山。

examples.en: The cold wind made my fingers numb.
examples.zh: 寒风冻得我的手指麻木了。

examples.en: Please put the milk back in the fridge.
examples.zh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱里。

examples.en: He hastily packed his bag and left.
examples.zh: 他匆忙收拾好包就离开了。

examples.en: She has always done well academically.
examples.zh: 她在学业上一直表现优异。

examples.en: School plays a big role in a child's socialization.
examples.zh: 学校在孩子的社会化中起着重要作用。

examples.en: His voice began to falter during the speech.
examples.zh: 演讲时他的声音开始变得支吾不稳。

examples.en: Don't make such a fuss over a small mistake.
examples.zh: 别为一个小错误如此大惊小怪。

examples.en: The warden walked through the quiet prison halls.
examples.zh: 典狱官走过安静的监狱走廊。

examples.en: To my amazement, she finished the race first.
examples.zh: 令我惊讶的是,她第一个跑完了比赛。

examples.en: The two old friends got along famously.
examples.zh: 这两位老朋友相处得非常融洽。

examples.en: She grows a beautiful purple orchid at home.
examples.zh: 她在家里养了一株美丽的紫色兰花。

examples.en: Cultural pluralism is valued in this city.
examples.zh: 这座城市重视文化多元。

examples.en: He kept his coins in a small leather pouch.
examples.zh: 他把硬币装在一个小皮袋里。

examples.en: Her recovery from the illness was miraculous.
examples.zh: 她从这场病中康复堪称奇迹。

examples.en: Police launched a crackdown on drunk driving.
examples.zh: 警方对酒后驾车展开了严厉打击。

examples.en: He didn't want to humiliate her in public.
examples.zh: 他不想当众羞辱她。

examples.en: She willingly helped her neighbor move the boxes.
examples.zh: 她欣然帮助邻居搬箱子。

examples.en: The moon affects the ocean through gravitational pull.
examples.zh: 月球通过引力影响着海洋。

examples.en: The school is a racially diverse community.
examples.zh: 这所学校是一个种族多元的社区。

examples.en: Many Cherokee people once lived in this region.
examples.zh: 许多彻罗基人曾经住在这个地区。

examples.en: The people fought bravely against the tyranny.
examples.zh: 人民勇敢地反抗暴政。

examples.en: Her breadth of knowledge impressed the teachers.
examples.zh: 她知识的广博给老师们留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: I still remember that day very vividly.
examples.zh: 我仍然清晰地记得那一天。

examples.en: At night the heavenly stars filled the sky.
examples.zh: 夜里,天上的星星布满了天空。

examples.en: The mice scurry away when the cat appears.
examples.zh: 猫一出现,老鼠就急忙跑开。

examples.en: The police finally caught the dangerous gangster.
examples.zh: 警方终于抓住了那个危险的歹徒。

examples.en: The dry, sterile soil grew almost nothing.
examples.zh: 这片干燥贫瘠的土壤几乎什么都长不出来。

examples.en: The kind woman donated money to the orphanage.
examples.zh: 那位善良的女士向孤儿院捐了钱。

examples.en: The countries signed a multilateral trade agreement.
examples.zh: 这些国家签署了一项多边贸易协定。

examples.en: The dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago.
examples.zh: 恐龙在数百万年前就灭绝了。

examples.en: The clean plates are in the kitchen cupboard.
examples.zh: 干净的盘子放在厨房的橱柜里。

examples.en: Her praise gave us the impetus to keep working.
examples.zh: 她的赞扬给了我们继续努力的动力。

examples.en: The baby had soft, plump little cheeks.
examples.zh: 那个婴儿有着柔软圆胖的小脸蛋。

examples.en: The young lad helped the old man cross the street.
examples.zh: 那个小伙子帮老人过了马路。

examples.en: They opposed any unilateral decision by one side.
examples.zh: 他们反对任何一方做出的单方面决定。

examples.en: The gorilla sat quietly eating leaves at the zoo.
examples.zh: 那只大猩猩在动物园里安静地吃着树叶。

examples.en: The bride wore a smooth white satin dress.
examples.zh: 新娘穿着一件光滑的白色缎子礼服。

examples.en: Language learning helps the assimilation of immigrants.
examples.zh: 学习语言有助于移民的同化。

examples.en: He applied for permanent residency in Canada.
examples.zh: 他申请了加拿大的永久居留权。

examples.en: Stop being such an asshole to your sister.
examples.zh: 别再这样对你妹妹这么讨厌了。

examples.en: All our efforts to save the plant were futile.
examples.zh: 我们挽救这株植物的一切努力都是徒劳的。

examples.en: The cultivation of good habits takes time.
examples.zh: 培养良好的习惯需要时间。

examples.en: The soup was a little too salty for me.
examples.zh: 这汤对我来说有点太咸了。

examples.en: Scientists posit that the universe is still expanding.
examples.zh: 科学家假设宇宙仍在膨胀。

examples.en: He used a sharp cutter to slice the box open.
examples.zh: 他用一把锋利的切割刀把箱子割开。

examples.en: A healthy diet keeps your bowel working well.
examples.zh: 健康的饮食能让你的肠道正常运作。

examples.en: The famous singer is the idol of many teenagers.
examples.zh: 这位著名歌手是许多青少年的偶像。

examples.en: New technology will reshape how we work.
examples.zh: 新技术将重塑我们的工作方式。

examples.en: The oil refinery employs thousands of workers.
examples.zh: 这家炼油厂雇用了数千名工人。

examples.en: Her bright red coat was very conspicuous.
examples.zh: 她那件鲜红的外套非常显眼。

examples.en: The tenor sang the high notes beautifully.
examples.zh: 那位男高音把高音唱得十分动听。

examples.en: Ordinarily, I walk to school every morning.
examples.zh: 通常情况下,我每天早上步行去学校。

examples.en: He wore a single gold stud in his ear.
examples.zh: 他耳朵上戴着一颗金色的耳钉。
